text: A woman with long, flowing red hair and a slender build kneels on a glowing circular pattern. Her skin is pale, face oval-shaped with striking red lips and intense eyes. She wears a white draped garment tied at the waist, revealing much of her torso and legs. A blue beaded choker and matching bracelet adorn her neck and wrist. Hands rest flat on the floor as she leans forward slightly, gazing upward. Behind her, dark shelves hold various vases and bottles in shadowy tones.
